# Notes: #4766 "How can I build `dxil` and `dxcompiler` as a static library?"

## Summary

Not a bug and not something a shader compile can measure. The reporter asks whether `dxil` and
`dxcompiler` can be built and linked as static libraries. A contributor (MarijnS95) narrows this
to a concrete, still-unactioned ask: drop or parameterise `SHARED` in
`add_clang_library(dxcompiler SHARED ${SOURCES})`
(`tools/clang/tools/dxcompiler/CMakeLists.txt:127`), and consider adding a `STATIC`
option/target so consumers get a self-contained static archive.

Ground truth used: local Debug build self-reporting `7665270b9` (fork-local), verified equivalent
in tree to public upstream `89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df` — `git diff --name-only
7665270b9 89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df` touches only files under
`.github/skills/dxc-issue-triage/` (0 files elsewhere out of 5315 changed), while the same diff
against `89e2f98e29c289ae8ad9e00dd310104fea9fd7df~200` (a control, proving the check can detect a
real difference) shows 609 files outside that directory. `dxc --version` matches the registered
compiler's self-reported string. See `manual-case-cmake-history.txt`, generated by
`capture-cmake-history.py`.

## What was measured (source/build-config, not a compile)

There is no shader and no `dxc` invocation that can answer "can this be built as a static
library" — the thing under test is CMake target configuration, so `match.json`/`cmd.txt` are
deliberately absent, per the skill's guidance for build-system issues (`#2604`, `#3276`,
`#3686`).

1. **`dxcompiler`'s CMake target is still hardcoded `SHARED`, unconditionally.**
   `tools/clang/tools/dxcompiler/CMakeLists.txt:127` at the ground-truth commit reads
   `add_clang_library(dxcompiler SHARED ${SOURCES})`, exactly the line MarijnS95 linked in 2023
   (then at commit `667fb773c`). `git log -S "add_clang_library(dxcompiler" --follow` shows this
   line was introduced in `6ee4074a4` ("first commit", 2016-12-28) and has never been touched
   since — the file's own most recent commit, `6ea7cf1c1` (`[NFC][CMAKE] Fix warning on MacOS
   build (#8166)`, 2026-03-26), does not touch it. `llvm_add_library`
   (`cmake/modules/AddLLVM.cmake:371`, which `add_clang_library` forwards to) supports both
   `SHARED` and `STATIC`, and would already build a static target if `SHARED` were dropped or made
   conditional — the contributor's "pretty trivial" claim is corroborated by the macro itself, but
   the change was never made.

2. **`dxildll` (`dxil.dll`) has the identical unaddressed pattern.** It was only moved into this
   repository by `9e039e254` (`Move dxil.dll to DXC repo. (#6866)`, 2024-09-05) — i.e. at the time
   this issue was filed (2022-11-04), `dxil`'s build wasn't even in this tree to change. Since
   being added, its `CMakeLists.txt` has never been touched again (single commit in its history)
   and hardcodes `add_clang_library(dxildll SHARED ${sources})` on both the `WIN32` and non-`WIN32`
   branches. So the second half of the title ("and `dxcompiler`") remains just as unaddressed as
   the first, and for most of this issue's life the question was not even answerable in-tree.

3. **No PR or maintainer comment in this thread proposes or declines the CMake change.** The
   thread has 4 comments (2023-03-09 x2, 2024-02-18, 2024-05-26) and no maintainer reply. The two
   non-MarijnS95 comments point at third-party/out-of-tree solutions instead of an in-tree one:
   `devshgraphicsprogramming` reports they ended up going shared anyway ("DXC doesn't compile
   under C++20 std option"), and later comments link external forks
   (`hexops/mach-dxcompiler`, `Oxsomi/DirectXShaderCompiler`) that patch `CMakeLists.txt`
   out-of-tree to get a static `dxcompiler.lib` — one of which reports it "completely breaks on
   linux". These are exactly the kind of hand-patched forks the issue's second half (a
   self-contained archive, portable across platforms) is asking to avoid needing.

4. **This issue is the acknowledged blocker for a related, still-open maintainer thread.** Issue
   `#5985` ("DllMain calls LoadLibrary for dxil.dll, could cause deadlock or crash") cites #4766
   explicitly. Contributor `amaiorano` (2023-11-09) writes that moving `DllMain`'s work into
   `DxcCreateInstance*` "should make using dxcompiler as a static library doable as DllMain won't
   need to be called at all (see this issue [#4766])", then (2023-11-15) that the change is
   "non-trivial" and would "require extensive testing." Maintainer `damyanp` asks on 2024-10-28
   "presumably this issue will go away once the code in dxil.dll is statically linked to
   dxcompiler.dll?" with no reply since. `include/dxc/Support/dxcapi.use.h:72` still calls
   `LoadLibraryA` from `DllMain` at ground truth, unchanged — so the precondition #5985 describes
   for making static linking safe has not been done either. #5985 remains `OPEN`.

## Cross-reference timeline

`gh api .../issues/4766/timeline` lists two cross-references, both already present in the issue
body/comments and read during step 1: `Traverse-Research/hassle-rs#57` (linked by MarijnS95's
first comment) and `microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler#5985` (discussed above). Neither is a fix or
a closing PR.

## Labels

Current: `build`, `api` — both still accurate; the ask is squarely build-configuration and
library-API surface. Proposing to add `enhancement`: the thread converged on a specific,
still-open feature ask (a `STATIC` CMake target/option), not merely an unanswered question, and
no `enhancement`-family label is present. Not proposing removal of anything.

## Caveats / what could not be determined

- No attempt was made to actually build `dxcompiler`/`dxildll` with `SHARED` dropped. Per the
  triage boundary for this issue (no rebuild/relink of any shared repository target, and no DXC
  source may be modified even transiently), this was evaluated by reading
  `cmake/modules/AddLLVM.cmake`'s `llvm_add_library` and by the fact that ordinary LLVM component
  libraries in this tree (e.g. `LLVMDXIL`, `LLVMDxilContainer`) are already static, not by
  compiling a static `dxcompiler.a`/`dxcompiler.lib` end to end. The claim "dropping `SHARED` is
  trivial" is corroborated (the macro supports it) but not independently proven by a build.
- Whether the two follow-on problems the contributor raised (self-contained static archive
  packaging; `DllMain`/ELF-constructor semantics under static linking) have been solved anywhere
  outside this repository (e.g. in the linked forks) was not investigated in depth — those forks
  are third-party and out of scope for a DXC-source-only triage.
- This was reviewed only against `main`/ground truth; no release-binary history applies, since
  there is nothing to bisect (a CMake target's `SHARED`/`STATIC` declaration is source, not
  compiler output).
